text: And Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:
“Should one try a word with you, will you be wearied? And who is able to be restrained from a word?
Behold, you have instructed many, and you have strengthened hands [that are] weak.
The one stumbling, your words, and bent knees you have strengthened.
But now it has come to you, and you are weary; it touches unto you, and you are disturbed.
Is not your fear your confidence, and the integrity of your ways your hope?
Remember please: Who [is] he [who has] perished being innocent? And where have the upright been cut off?
According to what I have seen, those plowing iniquity and sowing trouble—they shall reap it.
By the breath of God they perish, and by the blast of his nose they are consumed.
The roar of the lion and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions are broken.
The lion perishes for lack of prey, and the cubs of the lioness are scattered.
And to me a word was confided; and my ear took [in] a whisper of it.
In disquieting thoughts from visions of the night, in the falling of deep sleep upon men,
dread and trembling met me, and the multitude of my bones it frightened.
And a spirit was gliding over my face, the hair of my flesh bristled.
It stood still, I could not discern its appearance. A likeness [was] in front of my eyes; [there was] silence, and I heard a voice:
‘Shall a human be righteous more than God? Can a man be pure more than his Maker?
Behold, in His servants He does not trust, and His angels He charges with error;
how much more those dwelling [in] houses of clay, for whom their foundation is in the dust, [who] are crushed before a moth?
From morning to evening they are broken to pieces; without anyone noticing, they perish forever.
Has not their tent cord been pulled up with them? They will die, and not in wisdom?’
